item.title: How to set up a full web server on a Raspberry PI
item.description: In this post I am going to show you how to set up a fully operative web server on Raspberry PI. More specifically, this a LAMP server, which means Linux+Apache+MySQL+PHP, which the most common combination you find in most of the servers worldwide.
